video.title: The Resource Crunch Reshaping Global Power

description:
Rising resource nationalism and supply chain vulnerabilities are reshaping global power, investment priorities, and the future of economic resilience. Ellen Zentner, chief economic strategist and global head of Thematic and Macro Investing for Morgan Stanley Wealth Management, explains in a new audiocast.
________________________________________________

Listen to our latest thinking on various market topics from thought leaders within the Morgan Stanley Global Investment Office. Save this playlist to hear more or explore additional insights at https://mgstn.ly/3RjRak2. For a full-length version of this commentary, contact your Morgan Stanley Financial Advisor or find one here: https://mgstn.ly/3PAdDc7
